notes: Historical revenue and DD&A come directly from APA’s consolidated statement of operations and cash flow sections; values in the filing are shown in millions and were converted to full USD units. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

EBIT definition used for this input package: EBIT = net income before income taxes + financing costs, net (i.e., reversing financing costs from the pre-tax line), using the consolidated statement of operations. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

NWC definition used for this package: NWC = (Receivables, net + Other current assets) - (Accounts payable + Other current liabilities), excluding cash and current debt to align with an operating working-capital concept. NWC 2025/2024 from the FY2025 10-K balance sheet; NWC 2023 computed from the FY2024 10-K balance sheet copy (because the FY2025 10-K provides balance sheets only for 2025 and 2024). ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

Tax rate is a normalized GAAP effective income tax proxy computed from (current income tax provision + deferred income tax provision) / net income before income taxes averaged across 2024 and 2025; forward cash tax is not explicitly disclosed. WACC, terminal growth, and utilization are model assumptions. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

NOL balance equals the disclosed sum of U.S. ($9,463M) + state ($6,523M) + foreign ($211M) NOL carryforwards; NOL utilization modeled using the disclosed 80% taxable income limitation for post-2017 U.S. NOLs. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))
Current price used in assumptions is the latest market data snapshot available to this run (as of 2026-03-21).

catalysts: Execution vs. 2026 guidance: achievement (or undershoot) of cost-savings run-rate and capital efficiency. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

Production/reserve outcomes: inventory conversion and operational reliability across Permian/Egypt and North Sea decline management. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))
Commodity/hedging volatility that can swing revenue, EBIT, and cash flows year to year. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))
company_overview: Independent energy company with upstream operations in the United States, Egypt, and the offshore U.K. (North Sea), plus exploration activity in Suriname and other international locations. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

Consolidated financials present U.S. operations using successful efforts accounting for oil and gas properties. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

Noncontrolling interest relates primarily to minority participation in consolidated Egypt oil and gas operations. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))
current_context: Full-year 2025 results (GAAP): net cash provided by operating activities of $4.5B and free cash flow of $1.0B; net debt under $4.0B at year-end. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

2026 outlook: planned total upstream capital of $2.1B (10% reduction vs. 2025) and total adjusted production expected at 371,000 BOE/day, down year-over-year (North Sea, U.S. gas volumes, and asset sales). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

Cost discipline update: targeted run-rate controllable spend savings of $450M by year-end 2026. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))
investment_highlights: Capital discipline: lower 2026 upstream capital budget is expected to support free cash flow while offsetting inherent production declines. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

Margin thesis: base-case EBIT margin modeled to normalize modestly upward as cost reductions flow through relative to revenue, consistent with management’s cost-savings strategy. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

Balance-sheet support: debt reduction and controllable spend savings are modeled to reduce volatility and support a lower risk premium (WACC). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

Tax attributes: significant net operating loss carryforwards disclosed, with an 80% taxable income limitation for post-2017 generated U.S. NOLs (utilization modeled accordingly). ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))
key_risks: Downside commodity prices or realized differentials resulting in lower revenues and profitability than modeled. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

Impairments or higher-than-expected development/execution costs causing EBIT and capex intensity to deteriorate. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

Tax/regulatory risk (e.g., changes in minimum taxes or energy profits levy impacts) affecting effective cash taxes and after-tax value. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

presentation.subtitle: APA (APA) DCF Inputs: Cost-Discipline, Capital Efficiency, and Mature E&P Cash Flow
valuation_summary: DCF base case assumes modest revenue contraction followed by stabilization (revenue growth series reflects expected 2026 production decline and gradual normalization thereafter). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1841666/000184166626000012/exhibit9914q25earningsrele.htm))

EBIT margins are forecast to improve modestly from the depressed 2025 margin base, while DD&A and capex remain economically consistent with historical ratios and the disclosed 2026 capital intensity. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))

Terminal value uses a Gordon growth approach with 2% terminal growth to reflect mature, long-run real growth expectations for a mature upstream portfolio. ([investor.apacorp.com](https://investor.apacorp.com/static-files/d3ac75cd-4a45-4583-94eb-a02e6178424d))
